user_outcome: Agents can submit bounded scheduler and scrape jitter through default safe repair; humans receive machine-readable cadence, phase, tolerance, count, and displacement without alignment being confused with invented values or hidden gaps.
implementation: Added deterministic phase-aware bounded timestamp alignment shared by safe and aggressive repair.
Set tolerance to 1% of fixed cadence capped at 60 seconds and exposed it with phase and maximum displacement in repair metrics.
Made alignment all-or-nothing and rejected slot collisions with TIMESTAMP_ALIGNMENT_CONFLICT.
Removed aligned timestamps from the ceiling reserved for filled or conflict-resolved values.
Preserved the inferred cadence when aligned data reveals a real gap, so safe refuses precisely and aggressive can disclose its existing interpolation separately.
Recorded input reordering before repair sorting erases the evidence.
Updated CLI, MCP schema, repair options, and human documentation to distinguish safe alignment from aggressive value-changing repair.
